name: City Weather Field
description: A field that returns and displays the current weather for a configured city.
project_description:
City Weather field? 
 City Weather field allows returning the weather of the US city selected in the select list field.

 INSTALLATION 
 composer require drupal/city_weather_field 

 CONFIGURATION 
 After the installation,

 1- Before using the module, you need to set up the api key from https://home.openweathermap.org/api_keys in YOUR_DRUPAL_SITE/admin/config/city_weather_field/settings

 2- Create a new field 'City - weather' and select the US city, the weather information will be shown depends on the US city selected.
